instruction: Use VLC to convert the video to MP3 audio format and save the output file as 'Baby Justin Bieber.mp3' in the Desktop folder.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires converting video to MP3 audio using VLC Media Player. Evaluator verifies: (1) File exists (30%), (2) Correct filename 'Baby Justin Bieber.mp3' (25%), (3) File is actually audio format via MIME type check (25%), (4) File size is sufficient (>50KB, 20%). The MIME type check ensures the file is genuinely audio, not just renamed.
metadata.verification: Verified by checking: file existence on Desktop, exact filename match, MIME type verification to ensure it's audio/* format (not just .mp3 extension), and minimum 50KB size to confirm non-empty conversion.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: File exists (30%) + Correct filename (25%) + Is audio format (25%) + Sufficient size (20%) = 100%

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator verifies all instruction requirements (file conversion, correct filename, audio format, non-empty output)
Robust logic: MIME type verification using 'file' command ensures actual audio format, not just file extension
Correct data flow: Getter extracts file metadata from correct path (/home/user/Desktop/Baby Justin Bieber.mp3), metric compares all required properties
Proper edge case handling: Getter handles missing files and subprocess errors gracefully, metric short-circuits if file doesn't exist
Semantically correct expected values: basename='Baby Justin Bieber.mp3' and min_size=50000 are appropriate for the task
No UI state dependencies: File-based verification doesn't require postconfig or UI reopening
Sensible partial credit: 30%+25%+25%+20% scoring breakdown aligns with task importance
